pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped dark polygons with moderate edge angularity. Edge gradients are soft but maintain defined polygonal borders. Patch size is largest on the anterior flank and shoulder, becoming significantly smaller and more clustered on the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored channels. Junction nodes typically represent 3-way intersections. Channel thickness is variable, displaying narrow pathways between large mid-body patches and wider spacing toward the posterior region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck mane, displaying low-amplitude tufts against the background blur.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A large, localized area of significant de-pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper dorsal ridge and mid-flank, characterized by a pale, off-white coloration and absence of standard dark-patch geometry.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent pale, oval-shaped lesion or scar on the upper dorsal flank, displaying a loss of standard pigmentation and a distinct textural contrast with the surrounding hair patterns.
